concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-vulnerable-users]] — 2026-09-15 UK/Ireland Capital staff guidance for recognizing vulnerability, consent-sensitive tailored support and factual privacy-aware records; expressly not legal advice or proof of compliant service.
